findings.status: resolved by owner; independently verified static code correction
findings.summary: Unanchored lazy permissions-envelope regex permits repeated suffix scans on a malformed repeated-opening input.
findings.causalReason: An exact monitor prefix plus many newline-delimited opening markers and no closing marker gives the engine many candidate starts. Each candidate can scan the remaining text for a close. That is avoidable potentially quadratic recognition work on client-controlled system text. Static concern; no measured timing or runtime probe was run.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use linear ordered marker/line-boundary scanning rather than a repeated full-suffix regex. Retain same-block and exact-prefix semantics. Add long repeated-open/no-close negative and malformed/reversed-marker controls.
findings.resolution: Root replaced regex with one first-opening indexOf plus monotonically advancing closing scans, preserving same-block prefix and line boundaries, including empty permissions. Added 8192 repeated-opening/no-close rejection, empty-permissions positive and closing-extra-text rejection. Read-only review verified linear total scan; malformed-shape control alone does not prove asymptotic performance and no timing benchmark was run.
